name: Kulangsu, a Historic International Settlement
description: Kulangsu is a tiny, car-free island of under two square kilometres, a short ferry ride from the city of Xiamen on China's southeast coast. Once an international settlement, it is crowded with villas and churches blending Southern Fujian, Western Classical and veranda-colonial styles, along with the local Amoy Deco. Visitors wander its winding lanes and beaches, among more than ten million guests a year.
